title: Big Bad Nachos
rawIngredients: 50g dairy-free cheese such as Garlic & Herb Cashew Cheese (optional)
1 x portion Ultimate Chilli (or leftovers from a previous meal)
method: Tip tortilla chips into a large ovenproof dish (about 30 x 23cm) to cover the bottom[cite: 5].
Slice jalapeños and scatter over the nachos[cite: 5]. Add the dairy-free cheese[cite: 5].
Bake in the oven for 10–15 minutes until tortilla chips begin to brown and chilli is heated through[cite: 5].
Dot spoonfuls of guacamole and salsa over the top, scatter with chopped coriander leaves, and serve[cite: 5].
